description: Archive extraction preflight: zip-slip, duplicate destinations, symlink conflicts — Checks a manifest of up to 2000 archive entries (path, type, link target, sizes) before extraction, for an agent that unpacks zip, tar or OOXML files: ../ traversal (also through backslashes), absolute, drive-letter and UNC paths, entries that write through a symlink, symlink and hardlink targets that leave the root, duplicate destinations, case-only and NFC/NFD collisions, Windows reserved names,

destinationRoot.description: Extraction directory; counted towards total path length.

entries.description: At most 200000 characters of paths and link targets in total.

linkTarget.description: Required for symlink and hardlink entries.

path.description: Entry name exactly as stored in the archive.

type.description: Default: dir when the name ends with /, else file.

targets.description: Filesystems to check collisions and name rules for. Default: windows, macos and linux.

name: archive-preflight
